# Skills

Criteria and methods of this repository as skill documents for any AI coding agent, and for a person. Load the one that matches the work before you start.

- [`infrastructure-adopting-existing-resources`](infrastructure-adopting-existing-resources.md): Use when bringing a resource that already exists on Google Cloud, GitHub or Cloudflare under code in the infrastructure repository: generating the draft, writing import blocks, and knowing when the adoption is done.
- [`infrastructure-principles`](infrastructure-principles.md): Use when taking or proposing any design decision on the Cocreiamo infrastructure repository, reviewing a proposal or ADR, or choosing between tools or options: the criteria that decide, and the questions to answer before proposing.
- [`infrastructure-repository-conventions`](infrastructure-repository-conventions.md): Use when adding or moving files in the infrastructure repository, deciding whether something is an ADR, a skill, a runbook, a requirement or an issue, or changing CI, mise tasks, git hooks, formatting, linting, REUSE annotations, commit or pull request rules.

The content lives here, in plain Markdown with no vendor syntax. For Claude Code, `.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` is only a thin pointer: frontmatter that says when to use the skill, then an import of the file here. Another agent vendor wires its own pointers the same way, never copying the content. The name and the description are written once, at the top of each skill file; this index and the pointers are generated from them.
